Vision and values
Our vision is to become the energy company that others measure themselves against. These are the values we ask every person here to live by, in every office and on every site, every working day. They apply to every one of us, from the newest recruit to the chairman of the board, and we ask each other to point it out when we fall short.
respect We treat others as we would like to be treated ourselves. We do not tolerate abusive or careless treatment of anyone. Ruthlessness, callousness and arrogance have no place at Calderon.
integrity We work with customers and suppliers openly, honestly and sincerely. When we say we will do something, we do it. When we say we cannot or will not do something, we will not do it.
our people That's why we hire only the most talented people we can find. We give them room to take on new work and we expect a great deal of them. Their success is the success of the whole company.
our markets We believe in the lasting good sense of free and open markets. We think customers are best served when they can choose among suppliers and compare what each one offers.
innovation Calderon is a workshop for new ideas. We encourage people to question habits and to test better ways of doing things. Together we're building the most forward-looking energy company anywhere.
communication We have an obligation to talk with one another. Here we take the time to speak with each other and, just as much, to listen. We believe that information is meant to move and that it moves people.
citizenship We want to be good neighbours wherever we work. We try to leave each town a little better than we found it, and we ask our teams to give their time to the places they live in.
safety No job is so urgent that it cannot be done safely. Anyone may stop a piece of work that looks unsafe, and nobody will be criticised for stopping it.
partnership We look for relationships that last. We would rather win a customer for twenty years than win a single order, and we try to behave in a way that earns the second conversation.
accountability Each of us answers for the results of our own work. When something goes wrong we say so early, we explain what happened in plain words and we fix it before we look for anyone to blame.
excellence We are not satisfied with anything less than the very best we can do. We raise the bar for everyone around us. The great pleasure here is finding out how good we can really be.
